　初めてアルクェイドを見てしまった時、自分は確かに異常だった。

When I first laid eyes on Arcueid, something in me had undoubtedly gone mad.

I had. Shiki Tohno had lost his heart to the white vampire the instant he saw her.

“—”

If my love for Ciel was real, then my feelings for Arcueid were real too.
Roa’s influence had nothing to do with it.
Shiki Tohno had been drawn to Arcueid by feelings entirely his own—

“—”
Arcueid’s face lit up.
She released my arms and happily began to sit up.
